blurb: Guests kayak or paddleboard in the Indian River Lagoon area, experiencing wildlife such as manatees and dolphins, and natural phenomena like bioluminescence. Tours include daytime wildlife encounters and nighttime glowing water experiences using clear kayaks. Rentals are available by hour, day, or week, with options to take equipment offsite.
extraNote: Reservations required · Tours run June through October for bioluminescent season · Clear kayaks available until sold out; plastic kayaks at lower price · Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. · Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. · We look forward to seeing you. What to bring Sun screen Water Towels Change of clothes Bug spray (summer months and bioluminescent tours) Shoes you don’t mind getting wet, water shoes or sandals are best. You can go barefoot And your friends! -Arrive 30 min. Before your reservation time. -Tipping your guide is accepted.
